description: Set up cost or operational alert thresholds for a specific agent or org-wide. Alerts can trigger email notifications, webhooks, or automatically pause the agent. Use for real-time cost governance and operational safety. Thresholds run server-side automatically. Do NOT use for viewing current alerts — use get_alerts instead.

action.description: Action to trigger when threshold is breached

agent_id.description: Specific agent UUID to configure alerts for. Omit for org-wide alerts.

threshold_value.description: Threshold value. For costs: cents (e.g., 500000 = $5000). For rates: decimal (e.g., 0.1 = 10%). For latency: ms.

name: metrx_configure_alert_threshold
title: Configure Alert Threshold
